docTitle: Sumla Ga Shadu hku Chyum Laika · Chyum Laika langai sha hta
metaDesc: Ga Sadi Makam a aten lam, Yesu a asak, hte Pawlu a bu hkawm ni hpe teng man ai sumla ga shadu ntsa e hkan yu u — Chyum Laika gaw teng man ai shara ni hkan byin wa ai.

s.kicker: Chyum Laika langai sha hta · Sumla Ga Shadu
s.title: Sumla Ga Shadu hku Chyum Laika
s.verse: “Anhte a Madu Yesu Hkristu a hpung shingkang atsam hte du sa ai lam nanhte hpe chye shangun na matu anhte gaw masha e gyin shalat la ai maumwi hta shamyet shanat ai lam n galaw saga ai. Anhte a myi hte nan shi a galu kaba hkik hkam ai lam hpe mu lu saga ai.” (2 Petru 1:16)
s.purpose: Chyum Laika gaw maumwi adaw ahko n re. Teng man ai shara, aten hte mying ni ntsa e hkawm lai wa ai masha ni a labau rai nga ai. Dai lam ni hpe sumla ga shadu ntsa e, aten hku hkan yu u — shara langai hpe masawp u, n rai jang ▶ hpe dip nna lakang hte lakang hkan nang yu u.
s.ot_kick: ① Ga Sadi Makam — aten hku lai wa ai
s.ot_h: Hpan da ai kaw na Yerusalem de bai nhtang wa ai du hkra
s.ot_lead: Bu hkawm langai sha n re, hpan da ai kaw na hpang de hkye hkrang la ai labau a lwi ai lam rai nga ai: hpan da ai hte di hkrat ai → hka lim hte Babela → shaga ai lam (Abraham) → ga sadi jaw ai ga shara → Pru Mat Wa Ai → hkraw kawng → ga dang la ai → mungdan → garan mat ai → maigan mayam → bai nhtang wa ai.
s.je_kick: ② Ga Sadi Nnan — Yesu a asak
s.je_h: Behtelehem kaw na Yerusalem du hkra
s.je_lead: Kabu Gara Shiga mali tsun ai hte maren, Yesu a asak hpe aten hku hkan nang yu u — Behtelehem hta shangai ai kaw na hkalup hkrum ai hte Galile magam bungli, Samari hku lai nna, Yerusalem hta wudang, bai hkrung wa ai hte lung mat ai du hkra.
s.pa_kick: ③ Ga Sadi Nnan — Pawlu a bu hkawm ni
s.pa_h: Antiok kaw na mungkan ga shingjut du hkra — Roma
s.pa_lead: Yerusalem hta Pentekosta kaw na, Kabu Gara Shiga gaw Yuda mung shinggan de gara hku shabra wa ai — Asia Kaji hte Europa hku mungdan kaba a salum du hkra. Bu hkawm manga (1·2·3 + Roma de sa ai bu hkawm + lawt hkrum ai hpang) kaw na langai hpe lata nna, lam kaw ka da ai laika ni hte rau Kasa laika a lam ni hpe hkan nang yu u.
s.foot: Nhpang ni · Shara ni gaw Chyum Laika mungga hte Chyum Laika ga shara hpaji hpe hkan nang ai (akyu rawng ai shara hta ya na mying hte). Panglai kau, hka hte nawng ni gaw ahpaw ga shara matsing (Natural Earth) kaw na la nna, loi kadun galaw da ai.
s.contact: San ai lam · mahkrum madup — Email ka u

eden.name: Eden (Hpan da ai · Di hkrat ai)
eden.note: Grai kaja ai hku hpan da ai mungkan de, yubak shang wa nna Karai Kasang hte shinggyim masha lapran a sumtsaw hpe daw kau ai.
events: Shani matsat hta hpan da ai — “grai myit sharawng awng nga wu ai”
Masha hpe Karai Kasang a sumla hku hpan da ai
Di hkrat ai, Eden kaw na shapraw kau ai
Shawng nnan na Kabu Gara Shiga ga sadi — “Shi a amyu matu gaw na a baw hpe abrep”

noah.name: Ararat (Hka lim kaba)
noah.today: dai ni na Turki sinpraw maga, Ararat bum
noah.note: Karai Kasang gaw yubak hpring ai mungkan hpe tara dara ai, raitim dinghku langai hku asak hpe makawp maga ai.
events: Yubak hte hpring ai mungkan
Hka lim, hte Nawa a hka li
Sumpi ga shaka — “sha-u hte ginding aga hpe galoi mung bai n jahten kau na”

babel.name: Babela Lakhtawng
babel.note: Sumsing lamu de du hkra gumrawng ai hpe, Karai Kasang gaw shanhte a ga hte amyu ni hpe mungkan ga ntsa e shara shara de gayet kau ai.
events: “Lamu dep langchyi hte mare langai mi hpe anhte jawm galaw ga… anhte a matu amying gumhkawng shangun lu”
Karai Kasang gaw shanhte a ga hpe gayau kau ai
Amyu ni mungkan ga ntsa e bra mat wa ai (Shinara — hpang e Babelon)

ur.name: Ur
ur.today: dai ni na Irak dingda maga
ur.note: Chyum Laika a hkye hkrang la ai maumwi gaw masha langai hpe shaga ai kaw na hpang ai.
events: Karai Kasang gaw Abram hpe Kaldia amyu a Ur kaw na shaga la ai
“amyu kaba shatai na nngai… Na a marang e, amyu baw yawng hte hpe ngai shaman ya na nngai”
Makam masham hku shi gaw tinang a ga hpe kabai kau ai

haran.name: Haran
haran.today: dai ni na Turki dingda maga
haran.note: Lam kaw, ga sadi jaw ai ga shara de shaga ai hpe htan ai.
events: Tera a dinghku gaw Haran hta shanu nga ai
Tera si mat ai
Abram gaw asak 75 ning e Kanan de rawt sa wa ai

shechem.name: Shekem · Kanan
shechem.note: Ga sadi jaw ai ga shara hta dinghku langai hpang da nna ga shaka gaw kashu kasha de lai mat wa ai.
events: Kanan de shang ai, shawng nnan jaw jau shara — “Na a amyu matu mara ni hpe ngai jaw na ngu ai mungdan gaw ndai rai nga ai”
Ga shaka (Ningpawt Ninghpang 15) · Isak · Yakob
Yakob a kasha 12 — amyu 12 a ru rai nga ai

egypt.name: Egutu (Gawshen)
egypt.book: Ningpawt Ninghpang 37–50 · Pru Mat Wa Ai 1
egypt.today: dai ni na Egutu, Nail Hka delta ginra
egypt.note: Dinghku langai amyu kaba tai wa ai — dai hpang mayam amyu tai mat ai.
events: Yawsehpu gaw dut kau hkrum ai raitim Egutu hpe up hkang ai daraja de lung wa ai
Yakob a dinghku ting mu wan kawsi kaw na hprawng na matu yu wa ai
Mayat maya wa ai Israela amyu gaw mayam tai mat ai

sinai.name: Sinai Bum
sinai.book: Pru Mat Wa Ai · Jaw Jau
sinai.note: Ga Sadi Makam a ka-ang na hkye la ai lam — mayam ni Karai Kasang a amyu majing tai wa ai.
events: Mara jahkrat ai shi lam hte La Lai Poi sagu
Hkahkyeng Panglai hpaw nna shanhte rap mat ai
Tara Shi, Tara, Nawku Htingnu hte jaw jau ni

kadesh.name: Kadesh (hkraw kawng)
kadesh.today: dai ni na Sinai–Negeb hkraw kawng
kadesh.note: N kam ai a majaw amyu prat langai gaw ga shara sum kau ai — raitim Karai Kasang gaw shanhte hte rau naw nga ai.
events: Lagyim yu ai masha 12 — raitim amyu masha gaw kam ai hpe n hkap la ai
Hkraw kawng hta ning 38 — manna, sumwum sumut hte wan
Moab layang hta, Mawshe a hpang jahtum tara hkaw ai (Tara Jahprang)

jericho.name: Yeriko
jericho.note: Hpang jahtum e shanhte gaw ga sadi jaw ai ga shara de shang nna la la ai.
events: Yordan Hka hpaw nna amyu masha rap mat ai
Yeriko a sha-um ni hkrat ai
Kanan ga dang la ai hte ga garan la ai

shiloh.name: Shilo (Tara Agyi ni)
shiloh.note: Hkawhkam n nga ai majaw, masha shagu tinang ra ai hku galaw ai — teng sha rai ai hkawhkam langai ra nga ai.
events: Nawku Htingnu hpe Shilo hta jasan da ai
Yubak–roi rip ai–hkye la ai garung gara (Debora, Gideon, Samson)
Ruhta — nsin prat hta sadi dung ai, Dawi a amyu lakung hta

jerusalem.name: Yerusalem · Hkrum Sha Ai Mungdan
jerusalem.note: Israela a ahtoi htum aten — hte galoi n htum ai hkawhkam langai a ga sadi.
events: Shawng nnan hkawhkam Saula, dai hpang Dawi hte Goliat
Dawi hte ga shaka — “Na a magam tingnyang gaw galoi mung htum mat na ra ai n rai” (2 Samuela 7)
Shawlumon gaw Yerusalem hta Nawku Htingnu gap ai

samaria.name: Samari · Garan Mat Ai Mungdan
samaria.note: Myihtoi ni marawn nga ten, mungdan gaw garan mat nna npu de yu wa ai.
events: Shawlumon a hpang, Yuda hte Israela hku garan mat ai
Bai bai galaw ai sutrai nawku ai
Elia, Esaia, Yeremia gaw ‘bai wa marit’ ngu marawn ai — hte Hkristu a lam tsun shawng ai

nineveh.name: Ninewe (Asuria)
nineveh.note: Sadi jaw ai shagu hpe n madat ai majaw, dingdung mungdan shawng nnan hkrat sum ai.
events: Ninewe, Asuria mungdan a up shara
Dingdung mungdan gaw Asuria hku hkrat sum ai (BC 722)
Yona hpe Ninewe de dat dat ai

babylon.name: Babelon
babylon.note: Nsin htum ai na — raitim bai shanu la na ga sadi gaw naw nga ai.
events: Yerusalem hkrat sum ai, Nawku Htingnu hkru mat ai (BC 586)
Yuda hpe Babelon de woi sa kau ai
Daniela hte Ezekela — maigan mayam hta makam masham hte myihtoi mu mada ai

susa.name: Susa (Peresia)
susa.note: Karai Kasang n chye ai mungdan kaba a salum hta pyi, Karai Kasang gaw shi a amyu hpe makawp maga ai.
events: Peresia gaw Babelon hpe dang kau ai
Eshta gaw Yuda ni hpe amyu jahten kau na kaw na hkye la ai
Nehemia gaw hkawhkam a man e akyu hpyi nna dat dat hkrum ai

return.name: Yerusalem de bai nhtang wa ai
return.note: Shanhte nhtang wa nna bai gap ai — raitim hkawhkam n du wa ai. Shanhte gaw Hkristu hpe la nga ai.
events: Kuru a ga shaka hku lang masum hku nhtang wa ai (Zerubabela 538 · Ezra 458 · Nehemia 444)
Nawku Htingnu bai gap ai hte Yerusalem sha-um ni bai gap ai
Malahki — Ga Sadi Makam htum ai: “Nye a matu lam lajang ya na kasa hpe ngai shangun dat na nngai”

bethlehem.name: Behtelehem
bethlehem.note: Ga sadi jaw da ai Hkristu gaw Dawi a mare de sa wa ai — Mungga shinggyim hkrang la ai.
events: Dawi a mare Behtelehem hta shangai ai
Lamu kasa ni gaw sagu rem ai ni hpe shiga tsun dan ai
Sinpraw ga na hpaji sara ni nawku na matu sa wa ai

nazareth.name: Nazaret
nazareth.note: Karai Kasang gaw hprang hpra ai mare langai hta masha hku kaba wa ai.
events: Hpun lakang galaw sara a nta hta kaba wa ai
Asak 12 ning e, Nawku Htingnu hta ga san san nna htai ai
Hpang e tinang a mare a nawku jawng hta nra hkrum ai

jordan.name: Yordan Hka
jordan.today: dai ni na Yordan hka npu maga
jordan.note: Shi a shawa magam bungli hpang ai — sumsing lamu gaw shi hpe Kasha hku masat dan ai.
events: Yawhan gaw shi hpe hkalup ya ai
Wenyi gaw u hkru zawn yu wa ai — “Ndai wa gaw ngai sharawng awng nga ai, ngai tsaw ra ai Kasha rai nga li ai”
Hkraw kawng hta Satan a masum lang chyam yu ai hpe dang kau ai

cana.name: Kana
cana.note: Shi a shawng nnan kanawn masat hku tinang a hpung shingkang hpe shapraw dan ai.
events: Num la poi hta manam langai hku
Hka hpe tsa shai kau ai — shi a shawng nnan kanawn masat
Shi a sape ni gaw shi hpe kam sham ai

sychar.name: Sukhar (Samari)
sychar.note: Magam bungli a shawng nnan lam — Yerusalem hku lai nna, yu kaji hkrum ai Samari du hkra.
events: Yerusalem hta Nawku Htingnu hpe san seng shatai ai
Shana e, Nikodemu — “Nanhte yawng ntsa de nna shangai lu na”
Samari num langai a matu asak hkrung ai hka

capernaum.name: Kapernaum
capernaum.today: dai ni na Galile nawng kau
capernaum.note: Galile magam bungli a giwang shara — shaga ai, sharin ya ai hte ninghkap ai yawng ndai hta hkrum ai.
events: Nga hkwi sha ai ni hpe shaga nna ndai hta giwang shatai ai
Bum ntsa tara hkaw ai — “Wenyi hta matsan mayan rai nga ai hpe dum chye ai masha ni gaw a lu ma ai”
Mungdan a sumla ga ni — hte law wa ai ninghkap ai

galilee.name: Galile Nawng
galilee.note: Ninggawn tawa ntsa n-gun atsam hku shi gaw kadai rai ai hpe madun ai.
events: “Atsin sim rai nga u” — shi gaw nbung laru hpe zim shangun ai
Muk manga hte nga lahkawng hku masha 5,000 hpe jaw sha ai
Hka ntsa e hkawm ai

caesarea_p.name: Kaisaria Hpilipi
caesarea_p.note: Sape ni gaw shi Hkristu rai ai hpe chye la ai, wudang a lam mung hpaw wa ai.
events: Petru a hkam la ai ga — “Nang gaw Meshia ngu ai ahkrung nga ai Karai Kasang a Kasha rai nga ndai”
Shi a si na hte bai hkrung wa na lam hpe shawng nnan tsun shawng ai
Bum ntsa e hpung shingkang hte shinggyim hkrang galai ai

jericho.name: Yeriko
jericho.note: Yerusalem de lung wa ai lam kaw, shi gaw mat mat ai ni hpe tam ai.
events: Myi n mu ai Bartimai hpe myi mu shangun ai
Kang gun la ai Zakke hpe shaga ai
“Masha Kasha gaw mat mat ai ni hpe hkan tam nna hkye hkrang la na du sa ai rai nga ai”

bethany.name: Behtani
bethany.note: Shi a hpang jahtum bat a shawng shani e, si hkrung si htan ntsa e ahkang aya lu ai hpe madun ai.
events: Lasaru hpe lup kaw na bai hkrung shangun ai — “Ngai gaw bai hkrung rawt ai lam hte asak hkrung ai lam rai nga nngai”
Mari gaw shi hpe lup makoi na matu sau chya ya ai
Ndai kanawn masat gaw shi hpe sat na lam hpe grau ja shatai ai

jerusalem.name: Yerusalem
jerusalem.note: Chyum Laika ting madun ai ahtoi htum shara — wudang, bai hkrung wa ai, lung mat ai.
events: Awng dang ai hku shang wa ai; Nawku Htingnu na dut sha ai ni a sarin ni hpe kalang bai galau kau ai
Hpang jahtum shat sha ai poi hta sape ni a lagaw hpe kashin ya ai
Wudang ntsa e si ai
Shani masum ya hku bai hkrung wa nna, dai hpang lung mat ai

antioch.name: Antiok
antioch.note: Maigan amyu magam bungli hpang nna bai nhtang du ai dat shabra ai nawku hpung.
events: Akyu hpyi nga ten Wenyi gaw Barnaba hte Saulu hpe garan shapraw ai
Kam sham ai ni hpe shawng nnan ‘Hkristan’ ngu shamying ai nawku hpung
Bu hkawm 1, 2, 3 lang a rawt sa wa ai shara

seleucia.name: Seleukia
seleucia.note: Antiok a sanghpaw wang — shanhte Kupru de sanghpaw hte rawt sa wa ai.

salamis.name: Salami (Kupru)
salamis.note: Kupru hta shawng nnan hkring ai shara — nawku jawng ni hta Mungga hkaw dan ai.

paphos.name: Papho
paphos.note: Kabu Gara Shiga hpe ninghkap ai ni hpe n-gun atsam madun dan ai.
events: Myimang sara Eluma gaw myi n mu mat ai
Up hkang wa Sergiu Paulu gaw kam sham ai
Ndai kaw na ‘Pawlu’ ngu mying hte shawng lam woi ai

perga.name: Perga
perga.note: Pamhpulia a sanghpaw wang — ndai hta Yawhan Marku nhtang mat wa ai.

pantioch.name: Pisidia Antiok
pantioch.note: Kabu Gara Shiga gaw maigan amyu de hpaw wa ai.
events: Nawku jawng hta hkye hkrang la ai labau a tara galu hkaw dan ai
Maigan amyu law law kabu nna Mungga hpe hkap la ai
Ninghkap ai a majaw gau shapraw hkrum ai

iconium.name: Ikonium
iconium.note: Law law kam sham ai, raitim roi rip ai a majaw matut hkawm ra ai.

lystra.name: Lustra
lystra.note: Karai zawn shakawn hkrum, dai hpang nlung hte abyen hkrum ai.
events: Shangai ai kaw na lagaw kong ai la langai hpe shamai ya ai
Masha law law gaw shan hpe karai zawn jaw jau na hkyen ai
Nlung hte abyen nna si sai ngu kabai da hkrum ai raitim shi rawt wa ai

derbe.name: Derbe
derbe.note: Sape law law shatai ai; nawku hpung ni hpe gawngban shangun na matu shanhte a lam hku bai nhtang hkawm ai.

troas.name: Troa
troas.note: Kabu Gara Shiga shawng nnan Europa de sa wa ai galai ai shara.
events: Makedonia la langai a myihtoi mu mada ai
“Makedoni mung de rap sa nna anhte hpe karum la mi”
Shanhte kalang ta Europa de rap mat wa ai

philippi.name: Hpilipi
philippi.today: dai ni na Grik dingdung maga
philippi.note: Europa a shawng nnan nawku hpung — htawng kata hta pyi Kabu Gara Shiga awng dang ai.
events: Chyahkraw palawng dut ai num Ludia gaw kam sham ai
Myihtoi masu ai mayam num langai hpe lawt shangun ai
Yup tung e mahkawn, ga a-nan, htawng sin wa a dinghku hkye hkrum ai

thess.name: Htesaloni
thess.note: Mungga gaw myo hpe shamagoi kau ai hte ninghkap ai gaw grai kap wa ai.
events: Sabba masum lang nawku jawng hta tara jahkrum ai
“mungkan ting hpe gale galau di hkawm ai ni”
Shanhte shana e lagu hprawng mat ai

berea.name: Berea
berea.note: Mungga hpe tinang nan jep yu ai ‘myit su’ ai ni.
events: Shanhte gaw Mungga hpe myit dik hkra hkap la ai
Teng ai kun ngu shani shagu Chyum Laika hpe jep yu ai
Law law kam sham wa ai

athens.name: Athen
athens.note: Hpaji sara ni a myo hta shi gaw ‘n chye ai karai’ a lam hkaw dan ai.
events: Sutrai hte hpring ai myo a majaw myit machyi ai
Areopagu hta hpan da ai Wa hte bai hkrung wa ai lam hpe hkaw dan ai
Roi hkrum ai raitim nkau mi kam sham ai

corinth.name: Korinhtu
corinth.note: Yubak hte hpring ai myo hta nawku hpung langai hpang nna, ning mi hte shata kru nga ai.
events: Akula hte Prisila hte rau ginsum galaw ai
“Hkum hkrit… ngai nang hte rau rai nga nngai”
Korinhtu masha law law kam sham nna hkalup hkrum ai

ephesus.name: Ehpesu
ephesus.note: Bu hkawm masum lang a salum — Mungga gaw Asia ting de shabra ai.
events: Turannu a sharin ai jawng hta ning lahkawng shani shagu sharin ya ai
Myimang laika ni hpe nat kau ai; n-gun ja ai magam ni
Gumhpraw kahtam sara Demetriu gaw ganawng gasat ai lam hpang shangun ai

miletus.name: Miletu
miletus.note: Ehpesu salang ni hpe myi prwi hte lam hka ai.
events: “shi a Kasha a si hkam ai hte mari la ai hpung hpe sagu rem ni zawn bau rem nga mu”
Salang ni gaw shi hpe bai n mu sana ngu chye nna hkrap ai

caesarea.name: Kaisaria
caesarea.today: dai ni na Israela panglai kau
caesarea.note: Ning lahkawng, up hkang ai ni hte hkawhkam langai a man e Kabu Gara Shiga hpe makawp ai.
events: Up hkang ai Peliku hte Pestu a man e tara jep hkrum ai
Hkawhkam Agripa a man e tinang hpe makawp la ai
“Ngai hpe Hkawhkam Kehta hkum nan jeyang daw dan ya na matu hpyi lajin nngai” — Roma de matut sa wa ai

jerusalem.name: Yerusalem
jerusalem.note: Nawku Htingnu hta rim hkrum nna, shi a htawng masha lam hpang ai.
events: Nawku Htingnu hta masha law law gaw shi hpe rim la ai
Amyu salang zuphpawng a man e tinang hpe makawp la ai
Roma mungdan masha rai ai majaw, sin hkrum let Kaisaria de dat dat ai

myra.name: Mura
myra.note: Roma de sa na Aleksandria sanghpaw langai de galai jawn ai.

fairhaven.name: Fair Havens (Kreta)
fairhaven.note: Sanghpaw hkring na matu Pawlu a sadi jaw ai hpe n madat ai.

crete.name: Kreta
crete.note: Shi lawt hkrum ai hpang, nawku hpung ni hpe jasan da na matu Titu hpe tawn kau ai zinlawng.
events: Mare shagu hta salang ni hpe shatai na matu Titu hpe tawn da ai
Mara n nga ai, sadi dung ai woi awn ni hpe ra ai
Titu de laika ka ai

malta.name: Malta
malta.note: Nbung laru hte sanghpaw ga ai hku lai timung, Karai Kasang a ga sadi gaw shadaw nga ai.
events: ‘Sinpraw dingdung nbung’ gaw sanghpaw hpe ga kau ai, raitim masha 276 yawng lawt ai
Lapu gawa hkrum ai raitim shi hpa n byin ai
Zinlawng na machyi makaw ni hpe shamai ya ai

syracuse.name: Surakus
syracuse.note: Sisili hta shani masum nga ai.

puteoli.name: Puteoli
puteoli.note: Itali de du nna kam sham manang ni hte hkrum ai.

rome.name: Roma
rome.note: Kabu Gara Shiga gaw hpang jahtum e mungdan kaba a salum du hkra du wa ai — htum ai n re, hpang ai rai nga ai.
events: Ning lahkawng nta hta rim da hkrum let, mungdan a lam hpe gawngban ai hku hkaw dan ai
Ndai kaw na Htawng Laika ni (Ehpesu·Hpilipi·Kolose·Hpilemon) hpe ka ai

Hpang e bai htawng rawng nna, 2 Timohti ka ai hte makam masham a majaw sat hkrum ai — “Ngai gaw gat shingjawng ai lam hta atsam htum hkra gat shakut se ai; gat na matu tawn da ai shadawn shadang hpe htum hkra gat shadu se ai”
